answer: The orchard test I would run is Beekeeper queen cell mark sealed by the brood register: each queen cell is a wax seal pressed beside the keepers mark, so a farm must tend a hundred real hives by hand, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the copper of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the pearl of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
